label: Telling your partner
title: Telling your partner
intro: Many couples find it easier to talk once you both know the basics. There is no right way, only your way.
steps: Choose a calm, private moment, not in a rush.
Start with what it means: being a carrier means you are healthy.
Invite them to look at their own result, and decide together what to share.
phrases: I got my screening result. I'm a carrier, which means I'm healthy, but I'd like us to understand it together.
You don't have to share your result with me unless you want to.
Shall we talk it through with a counsellor together?

drafts.starter: I got my screening result. I'm a carrier, which means I'm healthy, but I'd like us to understand it together. Can we talk this evening?
drafts.starterNamed: {name}, I got my screening result. I'm a carrier, which means I'm healthy, but I'd like us to understand it together. Can we talk this evening?
drafts.gentler: When you have a quiet moment, could we talk? I got my screening result. I'm a carrier, which means I'm healthy. I'd love for us to understand it together, whenever feels right for you.
drafts.simpler: I got my screening result. I'm a carrier. That means I'm healthy. Can we talk about it together?
drafts.detail: I got my screening result. It shows I'm a carrier, which means I'm healthy and have no symptoms. It mainly matters if we plan to have children and you carry a change in the same gene. You don't have to share your result with me unless you want to. Could we talk this evening, or with a counsellor together?
